resources.string: Lets you watch one Instagram Reel or YouTube Short at a time, sends you back when you swipe to the next one, hides the Reels and Shorts tabs and the Explore grid. It also times the apps you set limits for and sends you to the home screen when a limit runs out. It sends nothing anywhere.
Explore is hidden.\nTap the search bar to find people.
Watch the Reel your friend sent. Skip the endless scrolling.
minutes a day, all limited apps together
Leaving the app for less than the lock time doesn\'t reset the count.

To turn it on: Accessibility → Installed apps (or Downloaded apps) → Eliminate Fluff blocker → On.\n\nIf the switch is greyed out (\"Restricted setting\"), go to Settings → Apps → Eliminate Fluff → ⋮ menu → Allow restricted settings, then try again.
